article.headline: NJIT earns 75-72 win over Binghamton in regular-season finale
article.description: — Tariq Francis' 29 points helped NJIT defeat Binghamton 75-72 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: NJIT earns 75-72 win over Binghamton in regular-season finale
article.story: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. -- — Tariq Francis' 29 points helped NJIT defeat Binghamton 75-72 on Tuesday. Binghamton will be seeded fifth and play fourth-seeded Albany in the first round of the America East Tournament on Saturday. NJIT's season is over. Francis also contributed seven rebounds for the Highlanders (6-25, 3-13 America East Conference). Tim Moore Jr. scored 22 points while shooting 7 for 9 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line and added five rebounds. Ari Fulton had 12 points and went 6 of 12 from the field. The Highlanders snapped an eight-game slide. Gavin Walsh finished with 19 points and 14 rebounds for the Bearcats (15-16, 7-9). Tymu Chenery added 17 points, four assists, two steals and two blocks for Binghamton. Nehemiah Benson had 15 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
